text:
kevin: Quick one  booking for a customer trip in 2 weeks. 3 Qs: 1) I need to expedite my passport renewal  can Redwood reimburse the expedite fee? 2) Visa support letter request  what do I attach to the expense? 3) I sometimes only get an emailed e-receipt for a local transit card  is that ok?

liz (People Ops): Short answers: 1) yes with manager pre-approval for business travel under tight timelines; submit the receipt and the manager approval note. 2) Attach the visa support letter request confirmation (Travel Ops or People Ops will supply) plus the paid visa invoice. If the consulate charges a separate handling fee, include that receipt. 3) e-receipts are fine  attach the email or PDF and your card/statement line showing the charge.

kevin: for the passport expedite  do I need preapproval before I pay?

liz (People Ops): Ideally yes. If its urgent and you pay first, flag the expense as "expedite - manager pre-approval pending" and DM your manager immediately. Finance may hold until approval is confirmed.

josh (Finance): From finance: include proof of business travel dates when claiming passport expedite fees. We convert any foreign receipts to USD at transaction rate. We do not reimburse personal renewal fees if the travel is optional.

kevin: visa support letter  who issues that?

travel-ops: We issue support letters on request. Please put the request into the travel-ops form (link: https://redwoodintranet.company/travel-ops) and CC your manager. The form gives a PDF you can attach to the visa application.

kevin: lost receipt for a $18 metro top-up  I have the bank charge only. acceptable?

josh (Finance): For <$25 missing receipts are accepted with a short note and the card transaction screenshot. Use the Missing Receipt form in Expensify.

kevin: last: can I use corporate card for Global Entry/TSA PreCheck application?
liz (People Ops): PreCheck/Global Entry fees are reimbursable if travel frequency justifies it and manager approves. We prefer employees pay and get reimbursed. If you need a corporate card, request one through Travel Ops prior to purchase.

kevin: thanks all, will get manager sign-off and submit the bundle.
